title: US fugitive wanted for sex offense arrested in Cebu
summary: The Bureau of Immigration identified the arrested foreigner as John Raymond Fenty, who was apprehended by operatives of the BI Fugitive Search Unit (FSU) in Barangay Buaya, Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu.
